plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Social Work and Community Studies Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published May 18, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7600/PublishedPdf). Certificate of Achievement (grade of C or better in each course). Official Total Units: 21-22; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path at the low end = 12+9 = 21 units (CSP 305/SOC 385 at 3 units). Semester sums verified against the map's 12 / 9-10 headers. Choice slots: (1) ME CSP 300 / SOC 380 — Introduction to Social Work and Human Services; (2) ME CSP 302 / SOC 375 — Introduction to Community Building and Change Making; (3) ME CSP 301 / SOC 382 — Introduction to Casework in Social Services; (4) ME SOC 321 / SOC 482 — Race, Ethnicity and Inequality in the United States; (5) ME CSP 305 / SOC 385 — Practicum in Sociology, Community Studies, and Community Health Work (3-4 units, modeled at 3; must complete a minimum of 3 units of CSP 305 or SOC 385); (6-7) two Major Elective slots (3 units each) — a minimum of 6 units (select 2 courses) from ADMJ 304, ADMJ 340, COMM 325, PSYC 370 or EDUC 300, PSYC 390, PSYC 405 or ADMJ 303, SOC 301, SOC 310, SOC 318 or ADMJ 349, SOC 335 or GERON 300, SOC 343. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
